metadata.description: Decision-trace tooling for Claude Code: an append-only record of why, an Oracle that reads it, and a scribe that keeps it current.

plugins.name: roeh
plugins.description: Roeh (רואה), the seer — an append-only decision trace for your project, an Oracle that answers 'why did we do X' from the record with citations, and a scribe that writes to it before compaction discards the reasoning.
